note: Production's authority profile, version 2 (P1-a). Nothing reads this file unless production's configuration names it: the portal's MINIMOI_MC_DELEGATION_AUTHORITY_FILE and the supervisor's MINIMOI_RUNTIME_AUTHORITY_FILE; with neither set, every store is today's version 1. Values are Robert's (spec v0.5 section 5.3, section 8.2): lease 120 s, renewed every 40 s; contact every 30 s, unreachable past 90 s; grace at most 8 h for an intermittent host and 30 min for an always-on one (each host states its own, cut to this); a frozen child stopped at its checkpoint after 10 min offline; the sweeper and the authority's liveness every 30 s, and a gap over 60 s (2 x contact) is the authority's own outage; progress timeouts build 30 min and review 10 min. API routes: 10 USD a day each and 3 USD per item. MC's judgment: at most 20 calls a day and under 1 USD a day (0.04 reserved a call, so 20 calls fit under the cap). The subscription routes keep today's per-job caps and no daily cap, so they admit nothing unattended. Every real route is supervised-only and launch_closure stays pending until the owner records both gating N5 items (R6.7-l, R6.7-h). fakework and fakejudge are the test routes (test units, no key, no spend): admitted here only because test_routes_in_production says so, for P1-a's integrated test; fakework runs only fakework, and fakejudge runs no worker (MC's judgment stand-in). No cross-host takeover (one worker host). A host's records replayed after a lapse are judged with 1 s of clock skew (section 2.5).
